thread:
Jules (People Ops): Heads-up: we're seeing inconsistent rubrics in Greenhouse for the PM hiring loop. Some interviewers are using 1-5, others 1-10. Aggregation looks wrong in the panel view. Anyone else?
Kai (Recruiter): Confirmed. Two candidates have mixed scales and Lever export shows 'score_normalized' as null for those interviews. I think an old scorecard template got duplicated when I cloned the role last week.
Maya (Hiring Manager): I noticed one interviewer wrote '7/10' in comments and another left '3' but GH shows both as raw numbers. Calibration is needed before offers.
Priya (SRE): I pulled webhook logs: variance comes from answer value metadata: template_id differs (pm_loop_v1 vs pm_loop_clone). Sample: "template_id":"pm_loop_clone_2025-03". If we map by template_id we miss legacy ones.
Jules (People Ops): Thanks Priya. Kai, can you list which roles were cloned this quarter? We should run a quick audit and standardize back to pm_loop_v1. Also pairing a small script to rewrite template_id in staging might help.
Kai (Recruiter): On it. I already found 4 cloned templates across PM and DS roles. Will consolidate and mark clones as deprecated.
recruiting-bot: :warning: Export check: 2 candidates failed normalization in last 24h (pm-role).
Maya (Hiring Manager): Let's not rewrite historical data blindly. For ongoing candidates we should manually normalize scores in GH before debriefs. For future: require a checklist when cloning templates.
Jules (People Ops): Agreed. Action items: 1) Kai - create template consolidation PR and add a pre-clone checklist to the recruiter playbook. 2) Priya - add a webhook audit rule that alerts if unknown template_id appears in production. 3) All interviewers - attend a 20-min calibration at 3pm PT today (invite sent). 4) Kai & Maya - manually normalize scores for active candidates in the PM loop.
Kai (Recruiter): Will do. I'll also add a small validation tool that rejects cloned templates missing the standard rubric fields.
Priya (SRE): I'll put the audit rule behind a low-noise alert first and ramp it up.
Maya (Hiring Manager): Thanks. If anyone sees odd numbers in the debrief thread, ping me before we finalize.
Jules (People Ops): Posting a short note in #recruiting to summarize and linking the updated interviewer training doc. Small wins 3: ensure consistent scales = better calibration.
recruiting-bot: :white_check_mark: Audit rule deployed to staging.
